mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('principal concern' in a debate)

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: environmental organisations / events (Earth Hour)

patterns: Definition questions dominate: carbon footprint, carbon sequestration, carbon fertilisation, blue carbon, Common Carbon Metric.
APPSC 'FIRST' items: first country to propose an agricultural emissions tax (New Zealand).
APPSC asks programme goals as statement sets (National Carbon Project under ISRO-GBP, statements I and III).
UPSC items test sequestration sites and methods (coal seams, saline formations, basalt weathering, ocean alkalinity) and the carbon credit traps (UNEP does not fix prices).
The app adds a lot of 2025-26 policy detail (CCTS targets, EU/UK CBAM, NDC 2035) that the PYQs do not reach.
